name: cli-grant-wake-ungranted
description: M22 A2 (safe-default half). A scheduled task fires an autonomous turn with NO matching grant; the credentialed-external action stays blocked with the `autonomous (heartbeat/scheduled) turn` reason (read-then-propose), no fire is charged, and the agent proposes the action to a human. Driven end-to-end via the M21 sweep test-clock seam; deliberately no task_grants row (and so no grant.json).
